sources.title: Ukraine travel bulletin
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland
sources.officialityEvidence: Finland's live Foreign Ministry Ukraine bulletin was updated 27 July 2026 and says martial-law travel restrictions can change quickly; it gives no current Finnish visa rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sotatilan vuoksi matkustusrajoitukset voivat muuttua nopeasti.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.ss service identifies the Interior Ministry immigration e-visa department and was last modified 22 July 2026, but it exposes no Finnish nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa replaces point-of-entry visa
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's live e-government guidance establishes electronic issuance and replacement of point-of-entry visas, but has no Finnish ordinary-passport eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L'eVisa remplace le visa délivré au point d'entrée dans le pays.

sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa application translation
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Sierra Leone eVisa service identifies the Interior Ministry as operator; its application asset says an approved online application ends in issuance at the terminal.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once you've been approved, you'll be issued your VISA upon arrival at the Terminal.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Liberia Immigration Service portal is an official .gov.lr arrival-visa service, but its route is conditional on residence and mission availability rather than a Finnish passport schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa on Arrival is available to applicants from countries without a Liberian Embassy.
